title: DIVER: A Robust Text-to-SQL System with Dynamic Interactive Value Linking and Evidence Reasoning
bound_sents: It helps establish a practical upper bound and shows the level of performance achievable when a model is provided with all necessary information.

As illustrated in Figure [ref] , the analysis compares the error distribution of the baseline model, the model augmented with DIVER-concise evidence, and an upper-bound performance with manually crafted golden evidence.
However, a performance gap still exists between DIVER and the Golden Evidence upper bound.
